comparison.objective: Match-mount tyres by aligning colored dots with a wheel mark or valve; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tyre/wheel feature alignment and mounting versus hex-key unlocking, collar turning, counterholding, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Specified tyre mark aligned to the appropriate wheel reference versus repeatable safe stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Shared rotational alignment is generic; the candidate tests setting retention and dynamic energy absorption, not match-mount placement.
